title: 第19章 宋锦来网咖找李西海
novel_title: 县城：女友出国要我卖房，给脸了
content_zh:
“哥，拉我拉我。”

    “卧槽，怎么连打带补的。”

    “这狗比人机，我的甲呀！”

    网咖包厢里。

    李西海与李西朋正在激烈的交战搜索撤离。

    在李西朋的显示器下，还摆着一个手机架，手机放在上面，画面正是同花顺，显示的是丰龙股份的行情走势。

    在顶尖魔王护暴力清图下，两人爽吃千万撤离。

    李西朋正好有空隙，在手机上滑了滑。

    “哥。”

    “这都五个板了。”

    “我们还不撤吗？”

    李西朋语气不无惊叹还带着询问。

    没错。

    距离丰龙股份复牌涨停，已经过去五个交易日。

    今天就是周一。

    五个交易日，五个涨停板。

    丰龙股份被广大股民解读为游毕选的借壳上市操作。

    机器人赛道，港股市值五百亿。

    正直机器人赛道火热，未来可期，还有这么一家大公司兜底。

    谁都看得出来，丰龙股份这一波必定是大行情。

    无数股民闻风而至，游资主力扎堆。

    但现在封板，每天的成交量少之又少，只有一些套牢解套，或者获利拿不住的丢出筹码，获利离场。

    五个板啊。

    李西朋的十万资金，现在都十六万，一周时间，就是六万的收益。

    他现在真的有点不淡定。

    六万收益对他来说，也是一笔不小的数目。

    但这钱来的太快，太轻松了啊。

    成天什么都不用干，看看行情，钱就在涨。

    他知道股市来钱很快，同样，亏的也快啊。

    李西雄五十万，三个跌停板，就亏了十几万。

    哪怕现在也涨回来了，谁知道什么时候突然跌停啊？

    “你自己拿主意。”李西海随口说道：“拿不拿得住，看你自己。”

    带他一把，吃口肉，算是他念及这么多年来的感情。

    你拿得住，继续吃。

    拿不住，也是赚。

    “额……。”

    李西朋弱弱的说道：“哥，你还拿着吗？”

    “拿。”

    李西海淡淡的说道。

    “那哥拿着，我也拿着。”

    李西朋想明白了，什么时候哥走，他也走。

    就在这时。

    李西海的绿泡泡响起消息的声音，他拿起来一看，有点意外。

    是宋锦发来的。

    加了这么久，双方还是第一次在绿泡泡有联系。
content_en:
"Brother, pull me, pull me."

    "Damn it, how come you can't even take the injections and supplements?"

    "This dog is better than a human machine, my armor!"

    In the Internet cafe box.

    Li Xihai and Li Xipeng were engaged in a fierce battle, searching and evacuating.

    Under Li Xipeng's monitor, there is also a mobile phone holder. The mobile phone is placed on it. The picture is a flush, showing the market trend of Fenglong shares.

    Under the protection of the top demon king, the two of them evacuated happily.

    Li Xipeng happened to have some free time and swiped on his phone.

    "Brother."

    "That's five boards."

    "Aren't we still retreating?"

    Li Xipeng's tone was full of wonder and questioning.

    That's right.

    It has been five trading days since Fenglong shares resumed trading at the daily limit.

    Today is Monday.

    Five trading days, five daily limits.

    Fenglong shares were interpreted by the majority of investors as a backdoor listing operation by You Bixuan.

    Robot track, Hong Kong stock market value is 50 billion.

    The upright robot track is hot and the future is promising, and there is such a big company taking care of it all.

    Everyone can see that this wave of Fenglong shares must be a big market.

    Countless investors came upon hearing the news, and the main players of hot money gathered together.

    But now that the market is closed, the daily trading volume is very small. There are only some people who are stuck and unwinding, or those who can't hold on to profits throw away chips and leave the market with profits.

    Five boards.

    Li Xipeng's capital of 100,000 yuan is now 160,000 yuan, which is a profit of 60,000 yuan in one week.

    He is really not calm now.

    The income of 60,000 yuan is also a large amount of money for him.

    But the money came so quickly and so easily.

    You don’t have to do anything all day long, just look at the market and your money is going up.

    He knows that money can be made quickly in the stock market, but losses can also be lost quickly.

    Li Xixiong lost 500,000 yuan, three times the limit fell, and lost more than 100,000 yuan.

    Even if it is back up now, who knows when it will suddenly drop to the limit?

    "You make up your own mind." Li Xihai said casually: "Whether you can decide or not depends on you."

    To take him with him and eat some meat is a feeling that he has cherished for so many years.

    If you can handle it, keep eating.

    Even if you can't hold it, you still make money.

    "Uh..."

    Li Xipeng said weakly: "Brother, do you still hold it?"

    "Take it."

    Li Xihai said lightly.

    "Brother, take it, and I'll take it too."

    Li Xipeng figured it out: when his brother leaves, he will leave too.

    Just then.

    Li Xihai's green bubble sounded the sound of news. He picked it up and looked at it, and was a little surprised.

    It was from Song Jin.

    After joining for so long, this is the first time the two parties have been in contact in the Green Bubble.
title_en: Chapter 19 Song Jin comes to the Internet cafe to find Li Xihai
